title: Fleet Scaling Policy Visualizer and Revision Timeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: ship a Fleet Controls UX feature that lets operators compose, preview, and compare autoscaling & throughput policies for Dedicated fleets and inspect a tamper-resistant revision timeline. Background: customers with Reserved capacity asked for an easier way to reason about policy changes and guarantees across hundreds of fleets. Existing console screens surface per-fleet throughput metrics and a flat change log; operators still struggle to understand the effective policy stack (global defaults, fleet-level overrides, canary policies) and to roll back safely. Goals: (1) visual policy composer that shows applied rules in priority order and estimated effect on tail latency and cost; (2) timeline UI showing diffs between revisions, actor, reason, and linked runbooks; (3) one-click rollback to previous revision with dry-run preview; (4) strong auditability for SOC/enterprise reviews. Out of scope for this ticket: backend multi-region replication logic and RBAC changes for policy edit permissions (separate tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Visualizer displays the effective policy stack for a selected fleet and highlights conflicting rules (color-coded)
Revision timeline shows all policy changes with author, timestamp, human reason, and link to related PR or runbook
Preview mode shows simulated throughput/latency delta for +/−10% traffic scenarios using current traffic profile
Rollback action reverts policy and creates a new revision (audit entry) and supports preview before commit
Backend API endpoints exist for fetching revisions and producing simulation scores; console calls these endpoints and handles 4xx/5xx gracefully
E2E tests cover composer save flow, timeline diffing, and rollback behavior on staging
qa_checklist: Smoke: open visualizer for 10 fleets with different configurations
Edge: composer handles >20 rules without layout breakage
Security: audit entries are immutable and visible to read-only roles
Integration: simulation results reasonably match lab results within 15%
rollout_plan: Phased rollout: feature flag behind account opt-in. Phase 1 (internal + select beta customers) for 2 weeks, gather telemetry and usability feedback. Phase 2 widen to 25% of accounts with Dedicated fleets for 1 week. Phase 3 full launch across console. For rollback, the console will default to 'preview' mode; only users with fleet-admin role can commit. Monitor metrics and have quick rollback to old UI via feature flag.
metrics: number of rollbacks performed via UI
mean time to apply policy change (goal: <90s)
